Create a production animation strip of TEN original transparent pixel-art sprites, arranged EXACTLY FIVE columns by TWO rows. One sprite per grid cell, wide landscape canvas. Detailed crisp clustered pixel art, selective dark stepped outlines, upper-left light; approximate2.5heads tall; elevated orthographic three-quarter top-down OVERWORLD view, not platformer/isometric.
